subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 6: final -y (my, cry, why, fly, sky); rhyming words; claps syllables in sight words

show.line: At the end of a word, y can say eye. My, cry, fly, sky!

rounds.prompt: Does it rhyme with sky? Sort the words.

hints: At the end, y says eye. My, sky.
Rhyming words sound the same at the end.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word. f, l, y.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It says fly. y at the end says eye.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's read it together. Fly. Birds fly in the sky!

parent_line: Knows that y at the end of a word can say eye, as in my, fly and sky.
